summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Direct exposure to this node is concentrated in visible large caps, but the more interesting Layer 1B expansion is the physical electrical infrastructure stack: transmission hardware, grid equipment, power quality, transformers, and nuclear fuel/advanced fuel components. The strongest underfollowed lane here is not hyperscalers or utilities themselves, but niche suppliers one or two steps upstream of grid capex and data-center power buildouts. Evidence is strongest for a few public names with narrow product exposure; several additional candidates remain hypotheses requiring verification of revenue mix and customer concentration. Broad reference names in this node are already crowded, so this pass expands the universe toward less obvious grid and electrical infrastructure suppliers that sit one step behind demand growth. The strongest underfollowed ideas are transmission hardware, power-quality / transformer suppliers, and niche HV equipment vendors that sell into utility capex, data-center electrical buildouts, and long-lead grid upgrades. Evidence is strongest for suppliers of physically constrained equipment with long qualification cycles and backlog-led demand pull-through; weaker candidates are included only as hypotheses requiring company-specific verification. Expanded the universe around second-order physical electrical infrastructure beneficiaries.
